name: Tiro
story: Co-founded with a friend. Version one was a marketplace matching design students with young companies; version two, a premium turnkey service run with a small freelance team. I owned prospecting, go-to-market and delivery.
decision: I chose to close it properly rather than let it drift.
lessons: Demand is not a business: both sides wanted the marketplace, but at around €50 of commission per project it couldn't pay. That's why we went premium.
Delivering was never the bottleneck, selling was. That's what pushed me to build prospecting machines, and into growth engineering.
A company run alongside studies and an internship hits a ceiling. I chose to close it properly rather than let it drift.
